description: Test suite for GatewayDiscoveryModel, including functions for matching local gateways, parsing TXT records, building SSH targets, and managing discovery process flow.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.LocalIdentity
classes.description: Represents local identity tokens used to identify local gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Represents a discovered gateway with connection details and identification.

methods.name: isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if the provided gateway details match the local gateway identity.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of TXT records from a gateway advertisement into structured fields.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from user, host, and port.

methods.name: shouldContinueTailscaleServeDiscovery
methods.description: Decides whether to continue discovery based on current and already found gateways.

methods.name: dedupeKey
methods.description: Generates a deduplication key for gateways based on available endpoint identifiers.
